summary: chore(content-server): delete the Backbone client app
description:
Because:
- The content server serves every user route with React.
- The Backbone app, its mocha tests and its webpack build have no use.
- The route gate only had a Backbone fallback.

This commit:
- Deletes app/scripts, app/tests, webpack config and the Backbone route modules.
- Serves React for each route group whose flag is on, with no gate.
- Fixes the consumers: validation, l10n-extract, tsconfig, tailwind, eslint, scripts.
- Removes the mocha test in misc.spec.ts.
- Returns the 404 page for paths with no React group.

Closes FXA-14816
